## Description

Cell of the stratified squamous epithelium lining the inner cheek: large (~50–80 µm), flat and
polygonal, with a small central nucleus (~8 µm). Scraped cells are the superficial ones, which shed
on their own; they usually carry oral bacteria stuck to them.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->

Prepared plates: `buccal_mucosa`.
